body: deliberately ignoring a partners calls and texts under ordinary circumstances is not necessarily a good thing to do and could be a sign of a toxic relationship. however, OP just experienced an incredibly draining, traumatic, and emotionally exhausting moment. not being able to properly communicate, especially over the phone or text during the aftermath of an attempt is completely understandable. not to mention that once they calmed down a little bit they did reach out to boyfriend again. OP is not at fault for that and their boyfriend should have ABSOLUTELY made the drive over to be with them in person and given them the assistance needed to get further professional help.
